title: lr schedules: peak lr, warmup, separate lr for Kerr c, decay from a large lr
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit)
initialization: complex Glorot normal, c = 0 (unchanged classes PaperComplexMLP / AblationComplexMLP)

baseline-check.description: const 1e-3 for both architectures, plus E008 check: cosine_to_zero 1e-3 for 'both'

select.criterion: mean over seeds of final validation BER reduction; configurations with a diverged seed excluded; test is not used

stage3.description: best config of stage1+stage2 by validation and the const 1e-3 control; decay horizon = budget

metrics.val_reduction: 100*(BER_raw - BER_model)/BER_raw on the 45 validation files; selection only
metrics.test_reduction: same on the 45 test files at the final step; report only
metrics.test_reduction_valbest_select: test reduction at the validation-best evaluation among steps divisible by 1000 (protocol of E007-E009); used for the control tolerance
metrics.T90_T95: first step after which validation reduction stays >= 0.90 / 0.95 of the control's final validation reduction (const 1e-3, 20k, mean over seeds) for 3 consecutive evaluations (every 250 steps)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
better_than_control_if_all: final test reduction >= control final test reduction - 0.5 p.p. (means over seeds)
no seed diverged: no NaN and final validation reduction >= control mean - 2 p.p.
